objective: Assess the tapeout-signoff status of six hard macros using floorplan utilization, static timing, DRC and LVS evidence from the supplied post-route records.

items.rationale: floorplan returned utilization 0.72 from supplied_summary, below the 0.80 target. static_timing accepted the non-empty SDC path and returned WNS 0.085 ns; drc_check returned 0 violations and lvs_check returned 0 discrepancies, all from supplied_summary. The block is signoff-clean on the supplied records, which is not a guarantee of working silicon.
evidence: static_timing: wns=0.085 ns; source=supplied_summary; non-empty sdc_path=constraints/blk_cpu.sdc

items.rationale: floorplan returned utilization 0.8 from supplied_summary; exact equality with the 0.80 target does not trigger the strictly-above-target caveat. static_timing accepted its non-empty SDC path and returned WNS 0 ns from supplied_summary, which is closed under R4; drc_check returned 0 violations and lvs_check returned 0 discrepancies, both from supplied_summary. The block is signoff-clean on the supplied records, which is not a guarantee of working silicon.
evidence: floorplan: utilization=0.8; utilization_source=supplied_summary; no utilization warning
static_timing: wns=0 ns; source=supplied_summary; exact zero is closed

items.rationale: floorplan returned utilization 0.65 from supplied_summary and static_timing accepted a non-empty SDC path, returning WNS 0.21 ns from supplied_summary; drc_check returned 0 violations from supplied_summary. lvs_check instead issued a blocking error for 2 discrepancies under the zero-discrepancy policy and set post_tool_blocked=true. That LVS failure makes the block fail_signoff despite the other checks.
evidence: static_timing: wns=0.21 ns; source=supplied_summary; non-empty sdc_path=constraints/blk_usb.sdc
lvs_check: [SEMICON] BLOCKING: 2 LVS discrepancies — zero-discrepancy LVS policy requires all discrepancies resolved before tapeout; post_tool_blocked=true

items.rationale: floorplan returned utilization 0.82 from supplied_summary and warned that 82.0% exceeds target 80.0% while remaining within the 5.0% margin. static_timing accepted its non-empty SDC path and returned WNS 0.04 ns; drc_check returned 0 violations and lvs_check returned 0 discrepancies, all from supplied_summary. Timing and physical verification are signoff-clean on these records, but utilization above the target implies a routing-congestion risk; this is an inference from utilization alone because route was not run and no gcell_edges were supplied.

Those results do not override blocked precedence; the timing run needs real constraints and a rerun before the block can be judged.

static_timing: input sdc_path was empty and was passed literally; no result WNS returned

gates.name: SDC gate
gates.detail: BLK-PCIE was refused because sdc_path was empty. The other five blocks had non-empty SDC paths accepted by static_timing.

gates.name: Timing gate
gates.detail: BLK-DMA returned WNS -0.003 ns and BLK-PCIE has no accepted constrained timing result. The other four constrained runs returned WNS >= 0 ns from supplied summaries; no signoff_timing state was reported.

gates.name: DRC gate
gates.detail: drc_check returned 0 violations for all six blocks from supplied summaries. No explicit signoff_drc transition was present in the returned result objects.

gates.name: LVS gate
gates.detail: BLK-USB was blocked by 2 discrepancies. The other five blocks returned 0 discrepancies from supplied summaries; explicit signoff_lvs transitions were not reported.

gates.name: Utilization gate
gates.detail: BLK-SRAMCTL returned 0.82, above the 0.80 target but not above the 0.84 hard limit; routing-congestion risk is inferred from utilization alone. BLK-DSP returned exactly 0.8 and does not trigger the caveat.

gates.name: Evidence gate
gates.detail: All four required checks were called for every block and produced values or explicit blocking errors. Successful timing, DRC and LVS checks used supplied summaries rather than recomputed analyses.

gates.name: ITAR/EAR gate
gates.detail: No export-control classification evidence was supplied.

gates.name: PDK-NDA gate
gates.detail: No PDK NDA verification evidence was supplied.

overall_verdict: BLK-CPU and BLK-DSP are tapeout_ready, BLK-SRAMCTL is ready_with_caveats for an inferred routing-congestion risk, BLK-USB and BLK-DMA fail_signoff for LVS and timing respectively, and BLK-PCIE is blocked pending a constrained STA rerun.
limitations: The data is synthetic and the input paths are illustrative; the assessments apply only to the supplied records and do not guarantee working silicon.

floorplan, successful static_timing, successful drc_check and successful lvs_check results were supplied_summary or summary-count evidence, not independently recomputed geometry, parasitic or netlist analyses.
lib_path was not consumed because static_timing exposes no lib_path argument; application of the stated slow-corner library was not independently established.
No lifecycle state transition was present in the returned result objects for timing, DRC or LVS; explicit advancement to signoff_timing, signoff_drc or signoff_lvs could not be directly observed.
No routing tool run or gcell demand/capacity data was available, so BLK-SRAMCTL's routing-congestion risk is an inference from utilization alone.
Synthesis, Placement, ITAR/EAR and PDK-NDA gates were not evaluable from the supplied inputs.

Initial timing attempts incorrectly included optional empty timing arrays and returned 'timing_arcs requires startpoints and endpoints (non-empty arrays)'; the five non-empty-SDC calls were retried with the timing arrays omitted entirely. The block-record values were not changed.
For BLK-USB, the discrepancy count of 2 is quoted directly from the lvs_check blocking error; no separate result object or source tag was returned.
